failure_modes.description: The domain of CSI influence does not have a finite or decaying bound.
The influence tail does not decay fast enough to ensure a finite sum.
Residue accumulation at the boundaries prevents sum convergence.
The distance metric for non-local transport is not well-defined for all points.
The sum depends on the order of evaluation (non-absolute convergence).
The sum appears to converge only because the evaluation was truncated.
Contributions below epsilon_null are incorrectly neglected or aliased.
Assuming global convergence without demonstrating local or conditional support.
